data.title: Sustaining and Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.

enrichment.summary: An early-career engineer who supports production operations, incident response, and customer-facing troubleshooting for Abacus Insights' healthcare data platform built on AWS and Databricks, while writing Python automation to reduce manual operational toil.

requirements.text: 2-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, SRE, technical support, production operations, data engineering, or a related field
Understanding of cloud computing and interest in supporting production systems in AWS
Basic Python programming skills; ability to read, troubleshoot, and modify existing scripts or services
Familiarity with Linux command-line tools, logs, APIs, or SQL-based troubleshooting
Basic understanding of incident response, root cause analysis, monitoring, alerting, and observability
Awareness of distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and Infrastructure as Code concepts
Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation and timely status updates
Structured troubleshooting mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to escalate when appropriate
Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through resolution with coaching and guidance
Curiosity, adaptability, and strong interest in production reliability and customer-facing engineering
Bachelor's Degree in engineering or related field
Internship, project, or work experience in a cloud, data, DevOps, technical support, or production operations environment
Exposure to Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, data pipelines, or other data platforms and warehouses
Familiarity with Kubernetes or EKS, EMR, Lambda, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies
Experience using ticketing, monitoring, logging, or incident management tools
Exposure to healthcare, regulated data, or security-conscious environments
Experience participating in an on-call, lab-support, service-desk, or operational support rotation
Customer-facing, consulting, implementation, or technical communication experience
